pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Partnerships and S corporations may elect pass-through entity tax (PTET), paid at the state individual rate (2.95% for 2026); owners get a credit. Rate wording for PTET not verified today beyond the bulletin's description of the election.

sources.title: Indiana DOR Income Tax Information Bulletin #72 (October 2024)
sources.quote: the 90% safe harbor for tax reasonably expected to be due applies only if the entity elects to be subject to PTET.

personal_exemption.notes: $1,000 per personal exemption; additional $1,000 if 65+ and/or blind; $1,500 per dependent; $3,000 per adopted child (withholding notice figures).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: County income tax on top of state tax (0.5% to 3.0% depending on county, see local_taxes). State rate falls to 2.9% in 2027 under current law (not verified today).

sources.title: Indiana DOR Departmental Notice #1, effective Jan. 1, 2026
sources.quote: For 2026, the state adjusted gross income tax rate for individuals is 2.95%.

sources.title: Indiana DOR Departmental Notice #1 - exemptions
sources.quote: Table A is used to figure personal exemptions. Each employee is entitled to deduct $1,000 per year

estimated_tax.required_if: expected to owe more than $1,000 for the year (not verified today)
estimated_tax.notes: Form ES-40; county tax included in estimates. Threshold and dates not re-read on an official page today.

unemployment_2026.notes: Most new employers pay 2.5% for the first four calendar years; construction: lesser of 4.0% or construction average. Wage base (believed $9,500) not found on a DWD page today.

local_taxes.name: County local income tax (LIT)
local_taxes.applies: Indiana residents on Jan. 1 at their county-of-residence rate (incl. self-employment income); nonresidents whose principal place of work or business is in an Indiana county on Jan. 1 at that county's rate
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Rates vary by county for 2026: lowest 0.5% (Porter), highest 3.0% (Randolph); e.g. Marion (Indianapolis) 2.02%, Allen 1.59%, Hamilton 1.10%, Lake 1.50%. Full list: https://www.in.gov/dor/files/dn01.pdf
local_taxes.quote: Indiana County Tax Rates: Effective Jan. 1, 2026 ... Marion 49 0.0202 ... Porter 64 0.005 ... Randolph 68 0.03

notable: 2026 state rate is 2.95% flat, but every county adds its own income tax of 0.5%-3.0% (https://www.in.gov/dor/files/dn01.pdf)
No standard deduction; only a $1,000 personal exemption (https://www.in.gov/dor/files/dn01.pdf)
PTET election available for partnerships and S corps (https://www.in.gov/dor/files/reference/ib72.pdf)

New SOS filing rules (HB 1593/HB 1666) took effect Jan. 1, 2026, e.g. remote businesses may keep a residential address off the public record (https://www.in.gov/sos/business/hb-1593-and-hb-1666-filing-process-changes)
